newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen ranging sideways, called higher.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen ranging sideways, called higher.

text.p: Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Cocoa is likely to range sideways as it builds support, analysts said on Wednesday.
Traders called benchmark September to open eight stg higher on figures, "but lacking the momentum perhaps to make that much early on," one said.
"More sideways ranging is possible," Susan Rigg of Chart Analysis said.
Strong support was at 1,000 stg a tonne and supply resistance at around 1,066, she said.
"Gains would be difficult to sustain," Rigg said. If it were to break through resistance there would not be a great deal of upside potential.
Were cocoa were to break through initial support at 1,023 Rigg would be looking for a renewed test of 1,000.
New York futures ended higher and toward the top of the day's range on Tuesday, bolstered by speculative and local short covering, dealers said.
